entities.summary: Eddie B. Robinson Jr. is an American former professional basketball player. A 6-foot-9-inch (2.06 m) shooting guard/small forward, he spent five seasons (1999–2004) in the National Basketball Association (NBA). In April 2017, Robinson was inducted into the NJCAA Hall of Fame in Las Vegas, Nevada.
